title: AgentSuite ToolProvider composition manifest

schemaVersion.description: AgentSuite specification version used by this manifest.

mediaType.description: Media type identifying a ToolProvider composition manifest.

version.description: Exact ToolProvider semantic version selected from the suite catalog.
